discription: A basic filtered saw wave with an ADSR envelope, offering a rich, subtractive synthesis texture.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, cutoff=2000;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);sig = Saw.ar(freq);sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq);sig = sig * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
